
 ◇ susynth › Help · night-drive • · no audio
 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

 Pages            Help · ↑↓ PgUp PgDn scroll
 ──────────────── ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  1 Play             PAGES
  2 Sets             Esc 1 … Esc 7          Play, Sets, Recordings, Sounds, Settings, Help, Perform
  3 Recordings       Esc f  /  Esc b        next / previous page
  4 Sounds           Esc                    from any page, back to Play
  5 Settings         Esc m                  the pages down the left: ↑↓ choose, Enter open, Esc back
  6 Help        ◂    The numbers are down the left. Press Esc, then the key within 1.5 s, or hold Alt.
  7 Perform          F1-F7 still open those pages when the terminal sends function keys.
                     KEYS ON EACH PAGE
                     Sets                   ↑↓ select · Enter load · a add to the set list · n new · d delete (twice)
                     Recordings             ↑↓ select · Enter show the path · d delete (twice)
                     Sounds                 ↑↓ select · ←→ fold a group · Enter preview or fold · i insert the example
                     Settings               ↑↓ select · ←→ change · Enter edit or reload where it says so
                     Help                   ↑↓ PgUp PgDn scroll
                     Perform                Enter go live · Esc n / Esc p next / previous · [ ] reorder · d remove

                     PLAYING
                     ^E                     run the block under the cursor (the whole live_loop; ┊ marks it)
                     Esc Enter              run the whole buffer, like Sonic Pi's Run
                     ^G                     stop every live_loop and thread, like Sonic Pi's Stop
                     ^P                     stop, or run the whole buffer again
                     ^R                     start / stop recording a WAV
                     ^S  ^O                 save / load a set by name (sets are .rb files)
                     Esc u  n               mute / unmute track n — a digit alone does nothing
                     Esc k  n               stop that track (Enter stops the loop under the cursor)
                     Esc s  n               solo track n (0 clears)
                     Esc l                  session log (errors, puts, cue) in the right pane; Alt+↑↓ scrolls
                     Esc - / =              level of the live_loop the cursor is in
                     Esc r                  switch the right-hand pane between Tracks and the piano roll
                     Esc t / a              next theme / next audio output
                     Esc x                  export the set as a MIDI file (runs silently in a second sandbox)
                     Esc n / p              perform: next / previous set in the set list
                     ^Q                     quit (asks once if there are unsaved changes)

                     EDITING
                     Shift + arrows         select text (also Shift+Home/End/PgUp/PgDn); ^A selects everything
                     ^C  ^X  ^V             copy / cut / paste; with nothing selected, copy or cut the whole line


  ▶ play  60 bpm  bar 1  ● ○ ○ ○  rec off                                                                 ^E run  ^G stop  ^P play  ^R rec  ^S/^O set  ^Q quit
